label: 510(k) Medical Device — Device Description + Performance
description: Device description, bench testing, electrical safety, and software documentation for NeuroSense Pro.

inputs.device_description: The NeuroSense Pro is a continuous electroencephalography (cEEG) monitoring system comprising a 32-channel bio-amplifier integrated into a wireless headset, a bedside base station, and proprietary software for real-time signal acquisition, display, storage, and analysis. The system incorporates a validated machine learning algorithm for automated seizure detection with real-time alerting.
inputs.principles_of_operation: Scalp EEG signals are acquired via 32 Ag/AgCl electrodes arranged in the 10-20 system with additional coverage. Signals are amplified (gain: 1000×), digitized (24-bit ADC, 500 Hz), and transmitted wirelessly (Bluetooth LE 5.2) to the base station. The base station runs real-time digital filtering (0.5–70 Hz bandpass, 50/60 Hz notch) and the CortexAI seizure detection algorithm.
inputs.comp_material_1: Medical-grade silicone frame, ABS housing, Ag/AgCl electrodes
inputs.comp_function_1: EEG signal acquisition and wireless transmission
inputs.comp_spec_1: 32 channels, 24-bit ADC, 500 Hz sampling, BLE 5.2, 12-hour battery
inputs.comp_material_2: ABS/PC housing, IEC 60601-1 compliant power supply
inputs.comp_function_2: Signal processing, display, storage, and alerting
inputs.comp_spec_2: Intel i7 processor, 15.6" touchscreen, 1 TB SSD, HL7 FHIR integration
inputs.comp_function_3: Real-time EEG display, seizure detection, report generation
inputs.comp_spec_3: IEC 62304 Class B, validated on 2,400+ annotated seizure events
inputs.bench_method_1: Synthetic signal input at 50 µV, 10 Hz; measure SNR across all channels
inputs.bench_method_3: Continuous 32-channel recording + BLE transmission until shutdown
inputs.elec_safety_result: Compliant — Type BF applied part, Class I (base station), internally powered (headset). All dielectric, leakage, and grounding tests passed.
inputs.emc_emission_result: Compliant — conducted and radiated emissions within limits. BLE emissions characterized and within FCC Part 15 limits.
inputs.emc_immunity_result: Compliant — ESD, radiated RF, conducted RF, power frequency magnetic field, voltage dips/interruptions all passed. EEG signal integrity maintained during all immunity tests.
inputs.sw_level_of_concern: Moderate (adjunctive seizure detection — clinician makes all treatment decisions)
inputs.sw_safety_class: Class B per IEC 62304 (non-serious injury possible if software failure)
inputs.cybersecurity: SBOM provided. TLS 1.3 for all network communications. BLE link encrypted (AES-128). User authentication required. Vulnerability assessment per FDA premarket cybersecurity guidance (2023).
inputs.labeling_summary: Labeling includes Instructions for Use (IFU), Quick Start Guide, electrode placement guide, cleaning/disinfection instructions, and operator training manual. All labeling reviewed for compliance with 21 CFR 801 and IEC 60601-1 Clause 7.
